editorial.blurb: A late-night sushi sanctuary where the chef's artistry shines through impeccably fresh fish, creative rolls, and carefully curated yakitori and grilled specialties that keep guests returning night after night.
editorial.insiderTip: Visit on Monday, Wednesday, or Friday when fresh fish arrives from overseas, and come after 8pm for the most lively atmosphere and best selection—the chef surprises regulars with nightly customizations.
